name: libmpcdec
description: libmpcdec, the Musepack SV7/SV8 decoder, from the musepack_src reference tree. Not to be confused with vcpkg's `mpc`, which is GNU MPC, a multiprecision arithmetic library.

tools.description: mpcenc, the reference encoder, which the test suite uses to build fixtures. Musepack has no packaged encoder on any platform this builds for.
